choice.basis: The dashboard legend maps pale yellow to the 'High' end of the Risk Index (100) and dark maroon to the 'Low' end (0). Among the available routing options, Rhode Island (RI) is colored pale yellow, indicating the highest risk. Delaware (DE) is orange (mid-range), and New Mexico (NM) is dark maroon (low risk). Therefore, RI is the correct record for the highest-risk priority follow-up workflow.
choice.option_label: Open Rhode Island (RI) risk detail for priority follow-up
